sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Jacket (114 key) is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A 2x2 slot blue jacket that has a chance to spawn the Dorm room 114 key and medkits.

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text: - Can only be found in the trunk of a blue car at the military checkpoint.
